subject.title: Telegram isolated polling ingress: updates spooled after the initial drain are never dispatched (silent message loss)

question: Should maintainers prioritize a focused current-main reproduction and assign the fix to the Telegram plugin or the shared durable ingress monitor once the missing wake-up boundary is identified?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-labeled and reports acknowledged inbound message loss, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether the defect is a Telegram-specific lifecycle gap or shared monitor behavior.

options.title: Reproduce and repair the owning layer
options.body: Run the reported two-update isolated-ingress scenario on current main and land a focused fix plus regression coverage at the proven owner boundary.

options.title: Request the retained harness and logs
options.body: Ask for the reporter’s redacted deterministic harness and debug logs if maintainers cannot reproduce the timing with the existing Telegram test infrastructure.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and repair the owning layer
recommendation.body: Run the reported two-update isolated-ingress scenario on current main and land a focused fix plus regression coverage at the proven owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared durable-ingress work makes this the strongest available routing candidate until source tracing establishes a Telegram-only owner.
